lerobot_v3_field_or_concept: data/ Parquet shards, videos/ MP4 shards, meta/ JSON or Parquet
mapping_recommendation: Keep UMI/Zarr as processed training export; create LeRobot v3 as interchange export from the same episode manifest.
notes: Do not delete raw GoPro/SLAM artifacts after conversion.

lerobot_v3_field_or_concept: meta/episodes records with episode length, offsets and tasks
mapping_recommendation: Convert episode_ends to per-episode start/end offsets, length and episode_index.
notes: UMI stores only end indices in the example; add task_id and quality fields in platform manifest.

umi_zarr_field_or_concept: /data/camera0_rgb, shape time x 224 x 224 x 3 uint8
lerobot_v3_field_or_concept: observation.images.<camera>, MP4 or images, feature declared in meta/info.json
mapping_recommendation: Map camera0_rgb to observation.images.wrist or observation.images.gripper; preserve original raw MP4 separately.
notes: LeRobot stores visual data as video/image assets while exposing tensors through loader API.

lerobot_v3_field_or_concept: observation.state slice, with field_descriptions added by platform
mapping_recommendation: Map into observation.state and document indices, unit and coordinate frame.
notes: LeRobot feature schema is extensible; industrial delivery should add coordinate-frame metadata.

lerobot_v3_field_or_concept: observation.state slice, with rotation representation in field_descriptions
mapping_recommendation: Map into observation.state and explicitly label axis-angle representation.
notes: Avoid silently converting to quaternion unless conversion code/version is recorded.

lerobot_v3_field_or_concept: observation.state slice and/or action gripper component depending task
mapping_recommendation: Store observed width in observation.state; store commanded/target width in action when available.
notes: Do not infer commanded action from observation without marking it as derived.

lerobot_v3_field_or_concept: episode metadata or optional observation.state fields
mapping_recommendation: Prefer episode-level metadata for start/end pose; include as state only if model consumes it.
notes: The UMI example includes these arrays; LeRobot does not require a direct equivalent.
